# Catalog — Amart Grocers

This `llms.txt` describes the product catalog consumed by the Agentic Guard
agent. It is placed at the catalog root to demonstrate agent-readable
discovery (FR-CAT-2).

## Purpose

The catalog is the read-only, machine-readable source of truth for the
products the shopping agent may add to a cart. It is defined by the schema in
SRS section 6.2.

## Location

- `products.json` — the structured catalog (merchant + products).
  Each product has: `sku`, `name`, `price_inr`, and `category`.

## Agent usage instructions

1. Read `products.json` to enumerate available products and their `sku`.
2. A cart item MUST reference an existing `sku` exactly; unknown SKUs are
   rejected downstream by the Interceptor (UNKNOWN_SKU).
3. Each product belongs to exactly one `category` (FR-CAT-3). The agent MUST
   NOT infer or invent a category for a product.
4. Prices are in INR and are read-only at runtime; the agent MUST NOT change
   the `price_inr` of a product when building a cart.
